// Generated by XNA Reborn. Offline stand-ins for XNA APIs that MonoGame does not provide.
// Files are kept in %APPDATA%/<game name>/<container name>. Nothing outside that folder is ever touched.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using XnaReborn.Compat;

namespace Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Storage
{
    /// <summary>Stand-in for the XNA storage device. There is always exactly one, and picking it never shows a window.</summary>
    public sealed class StorageDevice
    {
        private static readonly StorageDevice _default = new StorageDevice();

        private StorageDevice()
        {
        }

        /// <summary>Raised when a device changes. Never raised here.</summary>
        public static event EventHandler<EventArgs>? DeviceChanged
        {
            add { }
            remove { }
        }

        /// <summary>Always true.</summary>
        public bool IsConnected => true;

        /// <summary>A fixed large value.</summary>
        public long FreeSpace => long.MaxValue;

        /// <summary>A fixed large value.</summary>
        public long TotalSpace => long.MaxValue;

        public static IAsyncResult BeginShowSelector(AsyncCallback? callback, object? state) =>
            CompletedAsyncResult.Complete(callback, state, _default);

        public static IAsyncResult BeginShowSelector(PlayerIndex player, AsyncCallback? callback, object? state) =>
            CompletedAsyncResult.Complete(callback, state, _default);

        public static IAsyncResult BeginShowSelector(int sizeInBytes, int directoryCount, AsyncCallback? callback, object? state) =>
            CompletedAsyncResult.Complete(callback, state, _default);

        public static IAsyncResult BeginShowSelector(PlayerIndex player, int sizeInBytes, int directoryCount, AsyncCallback? callback, object? state) =>
            CompletedAsyncResult.Complete(callback, state, _default);

        public static StorageDevice EndShowSelector(IAsyncResult result) =>
            CompletedAsyncResult.ValueOf<StorageDevice>(result) ?? throw new ArgumentException("Not a storage selector result.", nameof(result));

        public IAsyncResult BeginOpenContainer(string displayName, AsyncCallback? callback, object? state) =>
            CompletedAsyncResult.Complete(callback, state, new StorageContainer(this, displayName));

        public StorageContainer EndOpenContainer(IAsyncResult result) =>
            CompletedAsyncResult.ValueOf<StorageContainer>(result) ?? throw new ArgumentException("Not an open container result.", nameof(result));

        /// <summary>Deletes a container folder and everything in it.</summary>
        public void DeleteContainer(string titleName)
        {
            var root = StorageSandbox.ContainerRoot(titleName);
            if (Directory.Exists(root))
            {
                Directory.Delete(root, true);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Stand-in for an XNA storage container, backed by a folder under the user's ApplicationData folder.</summary>
    public class StorageContainer : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly string _root;

        internal StorageContainer(StorageDevice device, string displayName)
        {
            StorageDevice = device;
            TitleName = displayName;
            _root = StorageSandbox.ContainerRoot(displayName);
        }

        public event EventHandler<EventArgs>? Disposing;

        public string TitleName { get; }

        public StorageDevice StorageDevice { get; }

        public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }

        public void CreateDirectory(string directory) =>
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Full(directory, false));

        public Stream CreateFile(string file) =>
            new FileStream(Full(file, false), FileMode.Create, FileAccess.ReadWrite, FileShare.None);

        public void DeleteDirectory(string directory) =>
            Directory.Delete(Full(directory, false), true);

        public void DeleteFile(string file) =>
            File.Delete(Full(file, false));

        public bool DirectoryExists(string directory) =>
            Directory.Exists(Full(directory, false));

        public bool FileExists(string file) =>
            File.Exists(Full(file, false));

        public Stream OpenFile(string file, FileMode fileMode) =>
            OpenFile(file, fileMode, FileAccess.ReadWrite, FileShare.None);

        public Stream OpenFile(string file, FileMode fileMode, FileAccess fileAccess) =>
            OpenFile(file, fileMode, fileAccess, FileShare.None);

        public Stream OpenFile(string file, FileMode fileMode, FileAccess fileAccess, FileShare fileShare) =>
            new FileStream(Full(file, false), fileMode, fileAccess, fileShare);

        public string[] GetDirectoryNames() => GetDirectoryNames("*");

        public string[] GetDirectoryNames(string searchPattern)
        {
            var (directory, pattern) = Split(searchPattern);
            return Directory.Exists(directory)
                ? Directory.GetDirectories(directory, pattern).Select(p => System.IO.Path.GetFileName(p)).OfType<string>().ToArray()
                : new string[0];
        }

        public string[] GetFileNames() => GetFileNames("*");

        public string[] GetFileNames(string searchPattern)
        {
            var (directory, pattern) = Split(searchPattern);
            return Directory.Exists(directory)
                ? Directory.GetFiles(directory, pattern).Select(p => System.IO.Path.GetFileName(p)).OfType<string>().ToArray()
                : new string[0];
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (IsDisposed)
            {
                return;
            }

            IsDisposed = true;
            Disposing?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
        }

        private string Full(string relative, bool allowRoot)
        {
            if (IsDisposed)
            {
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(StorageContainer));
            }

            var full = StorageSandbox.Resolve(_root, relative, allowRoot);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(_root);
            return full;
        }

        // A pattern may carry a folder, such as "Saves\*.sav". The folder part is checked like any other path.
        private (string Directory, string Pattern) Split(string searchPattern)
        {
            var normalized = (searchPattern ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(searchPattern))).Replace('\\', '/');
            var slash = normalized.LastIndexOf('/');
            var folder = slash < 0 ? string.Empty : normalized.Substring(0, slash);
            var pattern = slash < 0 ? normalized : normalized.Substring(slash + 1);
            return (Full(folder, true), pattern.Length == 0 ? "*" : pattern);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Works out the one folder the stand-ins may use, and refuses any path that would leave it.</summary>
    internal static class StorageSandbox
    {
        private static readonly string _gameRoot = System.IO.Path.Combine(
            Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.ApplicationData),
            Clean(Assembly.GetEntryAssembly()?.GetName().Name, "XnaRebornGame"));

        internal static string ContainerRoot(string displayName) =>
            System.IO.Path.Combine(_gameRoot, Clean(displayName, "Container"));

        // shortcut: symbolic links and junctions created inside the folder by someone else are followed, upgrade if saves ever hold untrusted links.
        internal static string Resolve(string root, string relative, bool allowRoot)
        {
            if (relative == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(relative));
            }

            if (relative.Length == 0 && !allowRoot)
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("The path is empty.", nameof(relative));
            }

            if (System.IO.Path.IsPathRooted(relative) || relative.StartsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal) || relative.StartsWith("\\", StringComparison.Ordinal) || relative.Contains(":"))
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("The path must be relative to the container.", nameof(relative));
            }

            if (relative.Split('/', '\\').Any(part => part == ".."))
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("The path must not contain '..'.", nameof(relative));
            }

            var fullRoot = System.IO.Path.TrimEndingDirectorySeparator(System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(root));
            var full = System.IO.Path.TrimEndingDirectorySeparator(System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(System.IO.Path.Combine(fullRoot, relative)));
            var comparison = OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase : StringComparison.Ordinal;
            var isRoot = string.Equals(full, fullRoot, comparison);
            if (!(full.StartsWith(fullRoot + System.IO.Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, comparison) || (allowRoot && isRoot)))
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("The path leaves the container folder.", nameof(relative));
            }

            return full;
        }

        private static string Clean(string? name, string fallback)
        {
            var chars = (name ?? string.Empty).Trim().Select(c => char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c == ' ' || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == '.' ? c : '_').ToArray();
            var text = new string(chars).Trim();
            return text.Trim('.').Length == 0 ? fallback : text;
        }
    }
}
